why: Auto chat placement: the daemon (acpmux place_auto.rs) decides when an Auto chat moves, off unless agentPane.autoPlacement.moveChats is on, and AcpmuxChatPlaceMover (CmuxNextAgentPane) carries chatPlace/move out; the App keeps only the composition-root wiring that needs App-only types: the mover property on AgentTabStore, creating it with QuitAgents.environment, finding the tab through listTabsScoped and calling the existing moveAgentToMachine (CloudMove / CloudBringBack actions on the App action registry), and the empty machine meaning any Cloud machine.
